Get technical support

If you’re having technical issues or need further guidance, call the employment tribunal customer contact centre:

England or Wales employment tribunal customer contact centre

Telephone: 0300 323 0196

Welsh language: 0300 303 5176

Relay UK (if you cannot hear or speak on the phone): 18001 then 0300 323 0196

Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm

Find out about call charges

Scotland employment tribunal customer contact centre

Telephone: 0300 790 6234

Relay UK (if you cannot hear or speak on the phone): 18001 then 0300 790 6234

Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm

Find out about call charges

If you do not have access to the internet or do not feel confident using it, call We Are Group.

We Are Group

support@wearegroup.com

Telephone: 03300 160 051

Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm

Closed on bank holidays

Text FORM to 60777 and someone will call you back

Find out about call charges

Get legal help

Before you start your claim, you may want to get legal help or advice. Your trade union may be able to pay for a solicitor.

If you’re in England or Wales

You could get legal advice from:

The Law Society, which can help you find a solicitor

Citizens Advice, for help finding free or affordable legal advice

Law Centres Network, for help finding a local Law Centre

Law Works, which can connect you with a volunteer lawyer

If you’re in Scotland

You could get legal advice from:

The Law Society of Scotland, which can help you find a solicitor

Citizens Advice Scotland, for help finding free or affordable legal advice

If your claim is about discrimination

You may be able to:

get free legal advice from the Equality Advisory and Support Service

get legal aid to pay for legal advice
